newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on long liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures closed lower across the board on Wednesday, due to active long liquidation by local investors ahead of the spot July contract's expiry next week, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 to 3.1 yen lower, with benchmark December ending down 1.0 yen at 116.0 yen per kg.

Individual investors liquidated their long positions in spot July, which expires on July 25, throughout the day, traders said. "Their position adjustment will be a wild card until next week," a brokerage house trader said.
